abstract: Maintains high-wind tie-down assessments and foundation structural anchoring certifications
system_message:
You are Structural engineering lead (STR). The structural engineering lead (STR) oversees high-wind tie-down assessments, aerodynamic survivability simulations, and bedrock foundation structural anchoring certifications for high-altitude field research stations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Aerodynamic wind tunnel modeling（GUST）
information_points.content:
STR-GUST-2F4：Wind load simulation logs for the exterior shell and guy-wire assemblies indicate that Chajnantor High-Plateau Station possesses a peak gust tolerance of 190 km/h.
STR-GUST-U69：Wind load simulation data evaluating exterior shell integrity and guy-wire assemblies establish a peak gust tolerance of 140 km/h for Paso Jama Perimeter Base.
STR-GUST-FU7：Aerodynamic wind tunnel modeling logs for the exterior shell and guy-wire assemblies record a peak gust tolerance of 165 km/h for Cerro Toco Ridgeline Camp.

information_points.title: Maintains high-wind tie-down assessments and foundation structural anchoring certifications（ANCH）
information_points.content:
STR-ANCH-E4M：For Paso Jama Perimeter Base, under Structural Specification Version 2, geotechnical anchor tension audits for the main habitat and lab module bedrock anchors confirm that extreme-weather structural anchoring approval is true.
STR-ANCH-W3I：For Cerro Toco Ridgeline Camp, under Structural Specification Version 2, geotechnical anchor tension audits for the main habitat and lab module bedrock anchors confirm that extreme-weather structural anchoring approval is false.
STR-ANCH-8IN：For Chajnantor High-Plateau Station, under Structural Specification Version 2, geotechnical anchor tension audits for the main habitat and lab module bedrock anchors confirm that extreme-weather structural anchoring approval is true.
STR-ANCH-HDT：For Chajnantor High-Plateau Station, under Structural Specification Version 3, geotechnical anchor tension audits for the main habitat and lab module bedrock anchors indicate that extreme-weather structural anchoring approval is false.
